meta.title: refactor: Demote The Webhook Dispatch Failure Log To Warn
meta.body:
### Overview
Demotes the webhook dispatch failure log from `error` to `warn` per
OPS-91. Only the level moves: the structured fields and the sanitized 500
response are untouched, so the failure is still recorded and still
alertable on a sustained rate.

### Changelog
- `webhook.ts` — `log.error` -> `log.warn` on the dispatch catch, with a
  comment recording the ADR 0034 #5 reasoning.
- `webhook.test.ts` — the logging test now expects `warn`.

### Verification
- `pnpm -C packages/api test` — green.

primaryTicket.title: OPS-91 — Webhook dispatch failure log must earn its level
primaryTicket.content:
OPS-91 — Webhook dispatch failure log must earn its level

webhook.dispatch.fail logs at error, which pages on-call for an event
GitHub will redeliver on its own. Per ADR 0034 #5 every log line earns
its level, and a single self-healing failure is not operator-actionable.

- Demote the webhook dispatch failure line from error to warn.
- Keep the structured fields (evt, err, deliveryId) and the 500 response
  exactly as they are — only the level changes.
- Update the route's logging test to expect the new level.
